what.text: This page follows refugees from Vietnam in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 20636 refugees from Vietnam.
France hosts the largest share, 36.8%, followed by the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between South Vietnam and Vietnam from 1965 to 1975, at war level in every year.
It also records interstate armed conflict between China and Vietnam in 1974 and in periods from 1978 to 1988.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1964 at 10000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 543536, at the end of 1995, and the main years of displacement in the data run from 1979 to 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
